title: Enhanced Enchanting & Enchantments
description: This mod adds more than 100 new enchantments that change the gameplay.
body:
This mod adds 116 new enchantments (50 on forge ) to vary gameplay.

If something isn't clear in the description tell it in comments I'm not english

Compatible with enchantment descriptions !(neoforge only)

// neoforge versions are highly recomended ! \\

(forge 1.20.1 won't be updated anymore)

This mod supports english  (en_us)  and french (fr_fr not fully)

Since 1.3.1.0 , a game rule exists to make certain legendary enchantments can't be used twice on the same item (neoforge only) (game rule is DoLimitLegendaryEnchantsToOne)

The mod also adds commands :

 by doing /enhanced_enchanting you can force add an enchantment (you can have 2 uncompatible enchantments on an item like sharpness and smite), remove an enchant, forbid it or unforbid it (parameter is forgive)

The mod adds 5 new blocks :

one named the enchanter that allow you with lapis lazuli to enchant an item at a level higher than 30 until 64 and to enchant it without limit but keep in mind that you can add a curse to your item

an other one is the enchantment upgrader that allows you to upgrade all the enchants of an item by 1 level for 32 echo shards ( can upgrade until level 74 by requiring one nether star per level above X (renders the roman number until 74 too)). To make it faster, this mod adds a recipe for echo shards that is one sculk shrieker for 16 echo shards (you have to put your item in the under slot, 16 echo shard in the middle slot and a nether for each level above 10 in the level after the upgrade in the higher slot)

The Lapis Lazuli cauldron that allows you to add a persistent enchantment to an item by throwing the item in it after having filled it with a stack of lapis lazuli

the Enchantment remover allows you to remove the enchantments that you don't want on your items

and the last is the Obsidian Grindstone that can remove curses only or legendary enchants only

The mod also add enchantment fusions, they triggers instantly when two compatible enchantments are on the same item, here is the list of all the fusions :

○ Fire Essence + Immortality = Pheonix

○ Vampire + Hunger = Blood Thirst

○ Pheonix + Beast Boss = Chicken Master

The mod also makes the shield enchantable with an enchantability of 10.
